title: world3 world map
description: Emitted by Phase F.3 world_plan_to_bundles.py from a validated world plan. Maps world coordinates -> bundle paths so the Phase F.7 streaming director can resolve 'what bundle covers position (x_m, z_m)' at runtime. Companion to the per-tile region_request files this iterator also emits.

plan_id.description: Source plan's id. Used as the worlds/<plan_id>/ output dir name.

seed.description: Source plan's seed, copied for provenance.

world_xy_m.description: World-coord SW corner of this tile in meters.

bundle_id.description: Unique id for this tile's bundle, derived as <plan_id>__tile_<col>_<row>.

request_path.description: Path to the per-tile region_request.json the iterator wrote.

bundle_dir.description: Path the orchestrator will produce the bundle into.

tile_seed.description: Deterministic per-tile seed: int(sha256(plan_seed || col || row)) mod 2^31.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the iterator ran. Provenance only; not used for runtime semantics.
